module_summary: NM-by-NS AXI4 crossbar: per-master skid buffers and address decoders raise slave requests, per-master arbiters grant channels with lingering, registered per-slave output muxes forward bursts, and skid-buffered return paths route B/R responses with pending-burst counters and an error responder.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Per-master write-address valid entering awskid skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: Per-master write-address ready from awskid skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Master write addresses buffered and decoded to select a slave

anchors.name: S_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Per-master write-data valid into wskid skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Master write data buffered then muxed to granted slave

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid back to each master from bskid

anchors.name: S_AXI_BRESP
anchors.why: Write response code routed back, interconnect error on decode miss

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Per-master read-address valid entering arskid skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Per-master read-address ready from arskid skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Master read addresses buffered and decoded to select a slave

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read data valid back to each master from rskid

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read data returned to masters through rskid from granted slave

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Registered per-slave write-address valid from granted master

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: Slave write-address ready; stalls AW output register

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Per-slave write address from registered output mux

anchors.name: M_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Registered per-slave write-data valid

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Per-slave write data muxed from granted master by swindex

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Registered per-slave read-address valid from granted master

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Slave read-address ready; stalls AR output register

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Per-slave read address from registered output mux

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Slave read data selected by mrindex for return to masters

anchors.name: wrequest
anchors.why: Per-master one-hot decoded slave request (plus error slot) for write arbitration

anchors.name: rrequest
anchors.why: Per-master one-hot decoded slave request (plus error slot) for read arbitration

anchors.name: dcd_awvalid
anchors.why: Address-decoder output valid qualifying write requests

anchors.name: wgrant
anchors.why: Per-master write grant vector over slaves and error channel

anchors.name: rgrant
anchors.why: Per-master read grant vector over slaves and error channel

anchors.name: mwgrant
anchors.why: Master holds any write grant; gates awaccepts and waccepts

anchors.name: mrgrant
anchors.why: Master holds any read grant; gates raccepts

anchors.name: swgrant
anchors.why: Slave write channel granted to some master; enables AW/W outputs

anchors.name: srgrant
anchors.why: Slave read channel granted to some master; enables AR output

anchors.name: mwindex
anchors.why: Slave index granted to each master; selects B response and ready

anchors.name: mrindex
anchors.why: Slave index granted to each master; selects R data return

anchors.name: swindex
anchors.why: Master index owning each slave write channel; drives AW/W mux

anchors.name: srindex
anchors.why: Master index owning each slave read channel; drives AR mux

anchors.name: W3_ARBITRATE_WRITE_REQUESTS[*].stay_on_channel
anchors.why: Holds current write grant while bursts pending

anchors.name: W3_ARBITRATE_WRITE_REQUESTS[*].leave_channel
anchors.why: Releases write grant when idle or another slave requested

anchors.name: W3_ARBITRATE_WRITE_REQUESTS[*].WRITE_LINGER.linger_counter
anchors.why: Counts OPT_LINGER idle clocks before closing a write channel

anchors.name: R3_ARBITRATE_READ_REQUESTS[*].stay_on_channel
anchors.why: Holds current read grant while reads outstanding

anchors.name: R3_ARBITRATE_READ_REQUESTS[*].leave_channel
anchors.why: Releases read grant when idle or another slave requested

anchors.name: R3_ARBITRATE_READ_REQUESTS[*].READ_LINGER.linger_counter
anchors.why: Counts OPT_LINGER idle clocks before closing a read channel

anchors.name: slave_awaccepts
anchors.why: Master AW request may proceed: granted, not full, slave ready

anchors.name: slave_waccepts
anchors.why: Master W beat may proceed to granted slave

anchors.name: slave_raccepts
anchors.why: Master AR request may proceed to granted slave or error path

anchors.name: W5_WRITE_SLAVE_OUTPUTS[*].sawstall
anchors.why: Stalls AW output register while slave not ready

anchors.name: R5_READ_SLAVE_OUTPUTS[*].arstall
anchors.why: Stalls AR output register while slave not ready

anchors.name: bskd_valid
anchors.why: Write response valid into bskid from slave or error responder

anchors.name: rskd_valid
anchors.why: Read data valid into rskid from slave or error responder

anchors.name: R6_READ_RETURN_CHANNEL[*].i_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data mux selecting granted slave's data via mrindex

anchors.name: berr_valid
anchors.why: Error responder pending B response for unmapped-address writes

anchors.name: rerr_none
anchors.why: No error-read burst in progress; gates raccepts and rskd_valid

anchors.name: rerr_outstanding
anchors.why: Beats remaining in error read burst for unmapped address

anchors.name: W7_COUNT_PENDING_WRITES[*].awpending
anchors.why: Outstanding write bursts per master; drives mwempty/mwfull

anchors.name: R7_COUNT_PENDING_READS[*].rpending
anchors.why: Outstanding read bursts per master; drives mrempty/mrfull

anchors.name: mwempty
anchors.why: No pending writes; allows write channel switch

anchors.name: mwfull
anchors.why: Write pending counter full; blocks new AW requests

anchors.name: mrempty
anchors.why: No pending reads; allows read channel switch

anchors.name: mrfull
anchors.why: Read pending counter full; blocks new AR requests

anchors.name: wdata_expected
anchors.why: W data owed for accepted AW bursts; gates waccepts

groups.name: write_request_decode
groups.description: Per-master AW/W skid buffers and address decoder producing one-hot write slave requests

groups.name: read_request_decode
groups.description: Per-master AR skid buffer and address decoder producing one-hot read slave requests

groups.name: write_arbiter
groups.description: Grants write channels master-to-slave, holds while pending, lingers idle channels

groups.name: read_arbiter
groups.description: Grants read channels master-to-slave, holds while pending, lingers idle channels

groups.name: write_slave_outputs
groups.description: Registered per-slave AW/W output muxes selecting granted master's request

groups.name: read_slave_outputs
groups.description: Registered per-slave AR output mux selecting granted master's request

groups.name: response_return
groups.description: B and R return muxes by mrindex/mwindex through skid buffers, plus interconnect error responder

groups.name: pending_counters
groups.description: Per-master outstanding burst counters producing empty/full flags for arbitration
